svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Frontend: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion; Backend & auth: Node.js, Express, tRPC, GraphQL, Better Auth, Python, Django; Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Drizzle, Prisma, Mongoose; Ship & design: Docker, Nginx, Linux, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Figma; AI: models OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama; build with Vercel AI SDK, MCP, Hugging Face; code with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex

g.text: APIs that don’t page me at 3am.
Any model your users need, wired into products that scale.
